newsitem.title: BOSNIA: Portuguese soldiers killed in Bosnia road crash.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese soldiers killed in Bosnia road crash.

text.p: Two Portuguese peacekeepers died and a third was seriously injured in a vehicle accident in eastern Bosnia over the weekend, the NATO-led Peace Implimentation Force said in a statement.
According to IFOR, the Portuguese Chaimite armoured personnel carrier rolled into a ravine while on patrol near Visegrad in Bosnian Serb territory on Sunday afternoon.
The three crew members were quickly flown to hospital but two died aboard the helicopter.

IFOR named the dead as Private Ricardo Manuel Dorges Souto, and Private Francisco Jose Barradas. Private Hugo Alexandre Da Silva Sousa, was being treated at the French Military Hospital at Rajlovac for injuries to his pelvis and feet.
